name: Lava Cake
summary: **Lava Cake** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] and a cross of [[thin-mint-gsc|Thin Mint GSC]] and [[grape-pie|Grape Pie]]. Multiple breeders, including Jungle Boys, [[breeder:Cannarado Genetics]], and Emerald Family Farms, have each circulated their own cut of the cross, and no single origin is documented. It is grown as an indica-leaning hybrid.

sources.title: Lava Cake Strain: A Frosty Hybrid with Dessert-Like Flavors
